locations.name: Keeper’s Yard
locations.description: A small fenced yard around a well; the player starts at the gate.

locations.name: Old Well Cave
locations.description: A dry cave under the well; stairs lead back up to the yard.

hero.start: At the gate of the Keeper’s Yard.

controls.input: 3D, third-person; keyboard & mouse; context-sensitive interact key.
controls.camera: Third-person follow camera behind and above the player.

types.name: Key item
types.usage: Opens or completes something; never sold.

items.name: Brass Key
items.description: Lies by the well in the Keeper’s Yard.

items.name: Stick
items.description: A stout stick from the yard.

items.name: Polished Key
items.description: The brass key, polished with two coins’ worth of care.

inventory.notes: No weight limit in the slice.

dialogueLines.name: Greeting
dialogueLines.speaker: refCharKeep
dialogueLines.text: Lost something? The old key went down by the well.

screens.name: HUD
screens.purpose: Shows the current quest objective, the coins and the 8 inventory slots.

ids.stability: IDs never change; renames only change display names.
